svg.title: SSEM theory and directly optimized embeddings

cc:Work.dc:title: SSEM theory and directly optimized embeddings
cc:Work.dc:description: A four-instance reproduction adapted from the authors’ code. Blue lines show SSEM predictions; hollow markers show means of three independent optimization runs.
